title: One executable description of CI, and a plugin that ships only what it runs
description: F1 of CONSOLIDATED-PLAN.md (quality-gates-internal, reports/2026-10-14-cost-code-ci-analysis, section 2.2; owner approval 2026-10-14 in DECISIONS.md, V1-V9). It touches the plugin's behaviour toward a user in two places only: `--selftest` on shipped entry points and `render-report --bench` go away (neither is promised by COMPATIBILITY.md), plus the falsifier, which the owner retired (2026-10-16, P128.17's cancellation). The CI half touches tools/ and .github/ only. Invariants established: I11 (plugins/audit/ holds only what the installed copy runs), I12 (B9 recorded at F1.5's landing SHA), I13 (a screenshot is stale exactly when what the page receives changed), I14-I17 (one executable gate description, a matrix derived from conditions, intermittents sought on purpose on the release tier, a verified SHA not re-run). ORDER: every task that edits plugins/audit/tests/ lands before F1.4 moves that directory to tests/, so F1.6, F1.6-falsifier and F1.7 run at their 571becfd paths and before the move, not after it as the plan had them; F1.5 follows F1.4. Stop criteria (plan section 5): F1.2 stops if a stress-only or stress-misses difference repeats in two attempts or the median wall exceeds 8m59s over at least five runs; F1.4-F1.5 stop if the prove-gates name set changes unexplained, a lint checks fewer references without a named reason, tests/ reaches the installed cache, the product imports from tools/, or the whole repo changes by 0.5k lines or more for a move; F1 ends only with B9 recorded and the repo smaller, not merely rearranged. Every figure was re-measured at 571becfd; the companion F1-NOTES.md carries each one, old beside new, with its command.
desiredOutcome: Every CI job is setup plus one `tools/verify.sh --only <slices>` call and a SHA already green on every job is not run again on main; every sweep leg is graded by the plain rules; the installed plugin carries no tests/, no lint modules, no demo generator and no bench, and its bytes are at most 10,416,128; B9 is recorded with the SHA it was measured at; a prose edit in _ui_theme.py no longer owes a screenshot recapture; and the retired lints and the falsifier are gone with their cases and prove-gates rows.

tasks.title: Every sweep leg is graded by the plain rules, and the codec leg's summary counts what it graded
tasks.description: Plan F1.1, invariant I15; absorbs P128.20 (register F677). (1) `grade()` in tools/sweep-selftests.py (def at :899 on 571becfd) loses its `encoding_pass` argument: a leg run under `--encoding`, alone or with `--spaced`, requires the `N/M cases passed` contract, counts cases, and reds a migrated file that prints the contract, exactly as the plain leg does. (2) A leg's heading names both conditions when both apply (`encoding pass (cp1252), spaced sweep`); each single condition keeps the heading it has today. (3) The codec leg's summary counts cases and migrated files the way the plain leg's does, so it never prints a count it did not take (P128.20's fault). (4) The grade-level case `g5` (:1721) goes; new cases run real children through `sweep()` in a scratch repository and assert: the codec reached the child; a live suite's cases are counted; a contract-free suite is red; a suite that swallows its own UnicodeEncodeError and exits 0 is red; a migrated file printing the contract is red; a combined-leg child sees cp1252 and a spaced, linked TMPDIR; the headings are pinned. (5) The ci.yml comment under the cp1252 step that describes the weak grade (ci.yml:271-276) is rewritten; no matrix literal changes. Starting point: korak0/C-work/sweep-grade.patch (or studies/C-poc/sweep-grade-v2.patch); at 571becfd its first hunk, the module docstring, no longer applies and the remaining hunks apply with offsets, so the docstring hunk is redone by hand. Acceptance: `python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py --selftest; echo $?` gives 0, run twice with a gap; `python3 korak0/C-work/probe/mutations.py <patched export>` reports every row killed and none NOT APPLIED (the plan cited studies/C-poc/probe/mutations.py, which holds the F1.2 checker rows instead); `grep -n encoding_pass tools/sweep-selftests.py` finds nothing.

tasks.title: CI runs one executable description of the gate set: every job is setup plus verify.sh --only, and a verified SHA is not run again
tasks.description: Plan F1.2, invariants I14-I17; the high-risk task of the phase. BEFORE LANDING, the probe of the CI study (C section 5.4): the new shape five times and the old shape three times on one SHA, at least 20 minutes apart and never overlapping, pushed to ci/study-c2 and ci/study-c2-skip. The owner pre-approved those two pushes (V5); the orchestrator still lists them before pushing, and the push and dispatch are the orchestrator's, never the executor's. Starting point: studies/C-poc/probe.patch; at 571becfd every file of it applies except its tools/sweep-selftests.py docstring hunk, which F1.1 supersedes. Precondition: F0's acceptance (sl4, hr2, rv13 absent from at least five Windows runs after P125.38 and P128.14); without it clause (4)'s deletion of the Windows cp1252 cells is dropped and the task lands without it. (1) tools/verify.sh gains named slices with `--only <slice,...>`, `--shard I/N`, `--list` (printed from the same `run` calls the script executes) and `--loud`, one line naming the interpreter, and a `RESAMPLE` table for the release tier. It keeps P128.12's cleanup as it landed: the EXIT trap plus `exit 130`/`exit 143` on INT/TERM, and gate-parity's vsh1-vsh8 cases that run those functions under dash survive wherever the parity code they sit in moves. (2) .github/workflows/ci.yml becomes jobs that are each setup plus one verify.sh call; `concurrency` cancels in progress outside main; a `tier` workflow input defaults to the per-run tier, because the drive's CI cadence (P128.2, `ci_dispatch`) and tools/release.py (:407) dispatch with `gh workflow run ci.yml --ref <ref>` and pass no input; release.py passes `-f tier=release`. (3) New tools/ci-verified.py: a push to main of a SHA whose run on this workflow file has every job `success` (not `skipped`) runs only the `verified` job and skips the rest; another commit's run, another workflow's run, the asking run itself, an unreadable job list and could-not-ask each refuse. (4) Deleted: ci.yml's inline shell (1,202 lines at 571becfd, 1,253 when the plan was measured), the three Windows cp1252 cells, the separate ubuntu cp1252 and spaced legs (six cells become three stress cells, cp1252 plus spaced), the docs/index.html leg, the inline `FRESH render` and `Usage section` steps (ci.yml:571, :593), the os.kill measurement step (:134) and the re-run of a verified SHA; in tools/gate-parity.py, `report_target_drift` (:1903) with its shell lexer, `sweep_leg_drift` (:2090), `step_guard_drift` (:3190), `step_exemption_breadth_drift` (:3065), `STEP_GUARD_EXEMPT` (:3038), the `shm*` cases that replace matrix literals, and the document sides of `compare` (:2846). (5) What parity keeps: every slice ci.yml names exists in `verify.sh --list`, every per-run slice has a job, and the shards cover 1..N (`shard_matrix_drift` rewritten, kept by V3). (6) Followers: tools/prove-gates.py rows for the removed checks; tools/check-rendered-artifacts.py `COPY_PROVEN` (:128); tools/affected.py report targets (`REPORT_GATE`, :89-91); plugins/audit/scripts/_refs.py `SWEEP_DOCS` (:2690) and its cases; CONTRIBUTING.md and PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md point at `verify.sh --list` instead of listing commands; CHANGELOG.md. (7) The CLAUDE.md Tests command list is replaced by a pointer to `verify.sh --list`: the task drafts that text in its outcome and the owner applies it. (8) Plan K6 (a red release resample is a bug in the plan) has no automatic path in F1, since P128.1 was cancelled into F2.8: until then a red resample is filed by hand with /audit:bug. Acceptance (C K1-K6, K1 relaxed to a median of at most 8m59s over at least five runs): `python3 studies/C-poc/read-c2.py --old ... --new ...; echo $?` gives 0, the exit code read at once and never through a pipe; `gh api repos/AleksandarBisevac/claude-plugins/actions/runs/<SKIP>/jobs` shows `verified=success` and every other job `skipped`; `sh tools/verify.sh --list` prints the slices; `sh tools/verify.sh --only lint` under dash leaves no `verify-*` in TMPDIR. The job count goes from 20 (the matrix is unchanged since edbbb86e) to 14, 15 on a push to main. NEW PATHS (absent at 571becfd, created by this task): tools/ci-verified.py.

tasks.title: A screenshot is stale exactly when what the page receives changed, not when _ui_theme.py's prose did
tasks.description: Plan F1.3, invariant I13. Today `_output.ui_surface_digests()` (:900) hashes the raw bytes of every source a surface is assembled from plus `_ui_theme.py`, so a docstring edit there owes a recapture of all 25 committed PNGs. (1) Each surface's digest is taken over what the page receives: the report as `_report_ui.CSS + "\0" + _report_ui.SCRIPT`, the panel as `_panel_page.UI_HTML`. (2) The plugin version is replaced by a fixed token before hashing, and every frozenset that reaches the assembled text is sorted first (`THEME_SINGLE`'s repr changes between interpreter runs). (3) PREMISE CORRECTION: the plan put this in _output.py, but _deps.LAYERS puts _output at layer 0, _report_ui at 4 and _panel_page at 6, and a lower layer may not import a higher one; the digest therefore lives in a new module above both (plugins/audit/scripts/_surface_digest.py, new, with its LAYERS entry, PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE tree line and section, PATH_PREAMBLE, `safe_stdio()` first and a suite in plugins/audit/tests/), and `ui_surface_sources()` stays where it is. (4) Its callers are repointed: tools/capture-screenshots.mjs (asks for the digest through python -c, about :6293) and `_refs.screenshot_capture_drift()` (:3439). (5) docs/screenshots/captured-at.json is rewritten once, because the meaning of its digest changes; that recapture is the orchestrator's (the capture lock is machine-wide), never an agent's. Acceptance: `python3 studies/K-poc/shot-digest.py studies/K-poc/shot/{base,prose,token}` gives the same digest for the prose edit and a different one for the token edit; `node tools/capture-screenshots.mjs --check` exits 0. NEW PATHS (absent at 571becfd, created by this task): plugins/audit/scripts/_surface_digest.py, plugins/audit/tests/test__surface_digest.py.

tasks.title: Each side has one git runner, and every caller keeps its own timeout and output truncation
tasks.description: Plan F1.6 (S3), the git-wrapper part, drafted apart from F1.6 because it reaches twenty-five modules. `git grep -E '^def _?git[A-Za-z0-9_]*\(' HEAD -- plugins/audit/scripts plugins/audit/hooks` matches 43 definitions at 571becfd (the same at edbbb86e), but that pattern also matches helpers that do not spawn git (`git_root_dir`, `git_root_rel`, `git_user_name`). (1) The wrappers in scope are the functions whose body spawns git; the outcome lists them, derived by reading each body, not by the name pattern. (2) Hooks may not import scripts/, so there are two homes: hooks/_config.py for the hook side and one scripts module, placed in _deps.LAYERS, for the rest. (3) Every caller keeps its timeout (the `timeout=` each wrapper defaults to today, 15 and 60 seconds among them), its output truncation and its error shape; a caller that differs passes its value explicitly rather than losing it. (4) No git argv changes. Acceptance: the full sweep is green, including tools/check-git-pipeline.py against a real repository; `git grep` for each removed wrapper name finds no definition; ruff and vermin clean.

tasks.title: The falsifier is retired: the drive no longer records, runs or decides on a planned test's mutation
tasks.description: Owner decision 2026-10-16 (P128.17 cancelled: the falsifier leaves the shipped tree under F1.6). PREMISE CORRECTION: P128.17 described `run_falsifier` as having no caller, but by 571becfd the feature is wired end to end (it shipped in 3.4.0's Added section): the executor declares falsifiers in its return, `record_falsifiers` writes them with `audit-task.py scope --falsifiers`, `run_falsifier` (drive-phase.py:1474) applies each in a throwaway tree after a green gate, and the `falsifier` decision stops the close. Retiring it is a removal from a live path. (1) drive-phase.py loses `run_falsifier`, `mutation_site`, `note_falsifiers`, `record_falsifiers`, the falsifier stage of the close, `FALSIFIER_TIMEOUT`, the `decide-falsifier` line and the `falsifier` decision with its answer handling, and `returned_falsifier_problems`. (2) An executor return that still carries a `falsifiers` field is filed and the field is not read (an agent body older than this change must not be refused); `_filed_returns.return_falsifiers` and `falsifier_gaps` go. (3) `audit-task.py scope` loses `--falsifiers`, and both argument-hint surfaces (commands/task.md, README.md) lose it. (4) _manifest_rules.py loses `task_falsifiers` and `falsifier_problems` and their `rules.falsifier.*` warnings. (5) The schema keeps `tests.falsifiers` and `$defs/falsifier` accepted, described as retired and read by nothing, so no plan that validated stops validating or starts warning; its removal is a 4.0.0 item beside `meta.muted` (an owner choice, see openChoices). (6) audit-lookup.py's brief text, agents/audit-executor.md, reference/execute-task.md and reference/phase-signoff.md stop describing it; the executor body shrinks (8,756 of its 9,000-byte ceiling at 571becfd, `python3 tools/measure-context.py --tree plugins/audit`), which the quality study's byte-neutral rule for agent bodies counts as headroom. (7) gen-demo-manifest.py's schema-coverage rows for the field say it is retired. (8) CHANGELOG.md records the removal under Removed. Acceptance: `git grep -n -i falsifier HEAD -- plugins/audit/scripts plugins/audit/agents plugins/audit/commands plugins/audit/reference` finds only the retirement notes; the full sweep is green.

(2) V3, approved: also retire isolation_drift (tools/gate-parity.py:1015) and ui_navigability_violations (_deps.py:4818). (3) exemption_reason_drift goes only if the parity check F1.2 left holds no exemption table with reasons; otherwise it stays and the outcome says so. (4) Kept: house_style_violations, fail_mode_drift, tests_import_violations, prose_number_claims, register_citation_violations, doc_prose_numbers, shard_matrix_drift (as F1.2 rewrote it) and affected_dispatch (until F3.2). The three lints added since the plan was measured (plain_read_violations, split_literal_violations, text_encoding_violations) are not in the D2 replay and stay. (5) The prose lints scan files git tracks, not an agent's untracked scratch files; where git cannot answer (an archive export) they fall back to the .gitignore derivation and say so. (6) A rule a retired lint held becomes author-enforced, and the documents that cite the lint say that: CONTRIBUTING.md, PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md, the three skill files, ui/shared/README.md. CLAUDE.md's isolation paragraph and its marker sentences are the owner's to change: the task drafts the replacement text in its outcome. Acceptance: the difference of `python3 tools/prove-gates.py --list | awk '{print $2}' | sort -u` before and after is exactly the retired names plus the four F1.2 removed; `python3 tools/prove-gates.py` once, both directions, green for the rest; the full sweep is green.
